# Support macros

Canned replies. They paraphrase policy and can lag behind it; the policy is authoritative. Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md). Routing: [support triage](../processes/support-triage.md).

## Refund macros
Within window: "Thanks for reaching out. Your subscription is eligible for a full refund and we have started it." Outside window: "The refund window for your plan has passed, but here is what we can do." Policy: [refund policy](../policies/refund-policy.md).

## Outage macros
"We are aware of the issue and a first response will follow within the target for your plan." Targets: [support SLA](../policies/support-sla.md).

## Login macros
"Please confirm your administrator assigned you to the application in your identity provider." See [SSO setup](../products/sso-setup.md).
